full_judgment: 3. The case is that the suit land originally belonged to one Hari Charan Mondal and Ramgati Mondal and on the death of Ramgati Mondal. Hari Charan Mondal became the sole owner of the suit land . While in possession Hari Charan Mondal died leaving behind only son Ram Krishna Mondal and the S.A. Khatian was prepared and finally publiShed in the name of Ram Krishna Mondal. The latter died leaving behind 4 sons. (Upendra Chandra Mondal. Muktinda Chandra Mondal. Jatindra Chandra Mondal and Panchannan Chanrda and by a family arrangement Upendra Chandra Mondal got the entire suit land measuring .30 decimals and his other brothers got other lands in other Khatians. While in possession the said Upendra Chandra Mondal sold the suit land to one Rustam Ali on 22.4.1969 by a registered Kabala. Rustam Ali mutated his name and sold .15 decimals of land by three registered kabalati on 24.12.1985 to Abdul Hamid Mahmud. Sharif Mahmud and Hasan Mahmud. The three purchasers by registered kabala dated 2.3.1991 sold the said .15 decimals of land to one Mr. Mobarak Hossain who again appointed Moharak Hossain as constituted attorney. The latter subsequently sold the entire .15 decimals of land to the plaintiffs. His further case of the plaintiff respondents is that Rustam Ali sold his remaining .15 decimals of land in favour of the plaintiff Nos.1 and 2. The plaintiff respondents mutated their names in Mutation Case No. 3336 of 1986 and have been possessing the suit land by constructing boundary wall As the defendants threatened the plaintiffs with dispossessing hence they filed Title Suit No. 31 of 1994 for permanent injunction .
